curated_skill_tap.install_policy: install reviewed skills individually; do not bypass Hermes plugin security scan

secrets.storage: Hermes .env or host secret files only

managed_runtimes.removal_contract: remove the dedicated venv and model cache only after no installed skill references rembg
disable employee variant before removing the isolated host service

shims.necessity: Continuum is a host-owned daemon and upstream exposes no product-specific client.
shims.rejected_simpler_alternative: The donor same-card bridge imports private GatewayRunner fields and owns delivery lifecycle state.
shims.removal_condition: Remove when Continuum ships a supported MCP server or upstream public origin/edit capability covers the contract.

shims.necessity: The rembg incident proved that main-venv and ambient-PATH checks can contradict the actual managed runtime.
shims.rejected_simpler_alternative: Checking only `which rembg` or the main Hermes venv produces false absence claims.
shims.removal_condition: Remove when upstream doctor supports component-declared interpreters, executables, versions, and cache roots.

shims.necessity: Operators need evidence-grounded correction when a later premise conflicts with completed tool receipts.
shims.rejected_simpler_alternative: A permanent core prompt edit increases fork drift for a tenant policy.
shims.removal_condition: Remove when upstream exposes an equivalent receipt-reconciliation policy configurable per profile.
